name: antika-docs
description: Antika Factory documents: invoices (وەسڵ) and receipt vouchers (سند قبض)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,shared -c blue,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w @antika/api" "npm run dev -w @antika/web" "npm run dev -w @antika/shared"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @antika/shared && npm run build -w @antika/api && npm run build -w @antika/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @antika/shared && npm run typecheck -w @antika/api && npm run typecheck -w @antika/web
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w @antika/shared && dotenv -e .env -- tsx apps/api/prisma/seed.ts
scripts.db:reset: dotenv -e .env -- prisma migrate reset --force --schema apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run db:seed
